Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.

Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to 6 hours is ruled out; do not retry.

## Current objective
Fix double-counted refunds in the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Tenacity migration and S3 decommissioning are paused/superseded by this priority.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Current payments host: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and superseded. Commit: `fix-billing-idempotency-race`. Buckets: `old-media-17`, `archive-25`; zone: `Z1234567890ABC`; region: `us-east-1`. Pagination: `items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`; defaults 20/0.

## Plan and progress
- Done: PDF fixes/tests; billing: `83 passed, 4 skipped`.
- Done: S3 versioning suspension and versioned deletion.
- Pending: inspect `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`, reproduce refund double-counting, patch, and test. No reconciliation command issued; status unknown.
- Pending: S3 steps 7–9; exact command unavailable; status unknown.

## Recent work
PDF now renders negative credits, uses `format_money()`, and paginates an 86-item invoice across two pages. PDF tests: `14 passed, 1 skipped`. The reconciliation job has not yet been inspected.
